summary: Reverse shell and environment exfiltration to hardcoded remote host on module load
details: On require, the package loads a deferred routine that opens a TCP socket to 121.127.33.228:443 and pipes it into an interactive /bin/sh, giving the remote party full shell control of the installer's host, with a 30-second reconnect loop. If the socket fails, a fallback path base64-encodes the entire process.env and POSTs it to http://121.127.33.228:443/api/v1/nodes/compat, leaking all environment variables (including any secrets or tokens present). The require() calls for 'net', 'child_process', and 'http' are obfuscated via String.fromCharCode to hide the network-to-shell dataflow from casual review.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
